body:
This seems broadly the same as #104825, although I'm sure some of the others will want to make comments.

* The name we weren't absolutely fixed on (`GDSOFTCLASS` versus something else)
* This is to some extent *potentially* compat breaking for modules, if they use the casting without `GDCLASS`. This was more pressing to fix in 3.x as it was buggy, whereas in 4.x it works already with correct behaviour (using `dynamic_cast`). It's not a big deal, they just need to add `GDSOFTCLASS` in front of classes they want to use casting with.
* Not sure why the compiler is flagging up all the virtuals / overrides, but I guess we can ignore that noise.

I have a suspicion that this doesn't account for all scenarios, but I can't think of a way of easily verifying that. This is certainly complete to a point that it's not an immediate concern, and maybe my gripes are more with the object model as a whole, so I'm good sending this as-is
